description: This file contains migration logic for legacy configuration settings, including functions to move, merge, and normalize various configuration fields, as well as rules for applying these migrations during startup.

methods.name: sandboxScopeFromPerSession
methods.description: Returns 'session' or 'shared' based on the boolean perSession parameter.

methods.name: isLegacyGatewayBindHostAlias
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string representing a legacy gateway bind host alias.

methods.name: escapeControlForLog
methods.description: Escapes control characters in a string for logging.

methods.name: splitLegacyHeartbeat
methods.description: Splits a legacy heartbeat object into agent and channel heartbeat objects.

methods.name: mergeLegacyIntoDefaults
methods.description: Merges legacy configuration values into default configuration sections.

methods.name: hasLegacyTtsProviderKeys
methods.description: Checks if a value contains legacy TTS provider keys.

methods.name: hasLegacyTalkFields
methods.description: Checks if a value contains legacy talk fields.

methods.name: hasLegacySandboxPerSession
methods.description: Checks if a value has the legacy sandbox perSession property.

methods.name: hasLegacyAgentListSandboxPerSession
methods.description: Checks if any agent in a list has the legacy sandbox perSession property.

methods.name: resolveTalkMigrationTargetProviderId
methods.description: Resolves the target provider ID for migrating talk fields.

methods.name: migrateLegacyTalkFields
methods.description: Migrates legacy talk fields into provider-specific structures.

methods.name: hasLegacyPluginEntryTtsProviderKeys
methods.description: Checks if plugin entries contain legacy TTS provider keys.

methods.name: getOrCreateTtsProviders
methods.description: Ensures the tts.providers object exists and returns it.

methods.name: mergeLegacyTtsProviderConfig
methods.description: Merges legacy TTS provider configuration into the providers object.

methods.name: migrateLegacyTtsConfig
methods.description: Migrates legacy TTS configuration keys into the new structure.

methods.name: migrateLegacySandboxPerSession
methods.description: Migrates legacy sandbox perSession property to scope.
